events.description: 23. MINUTE ORDER: Pursuant to notices that the parties do not waive judicial disqualification, ECF Nos. 19, 20, the Clerk's office is hereby ORDERED to reassign this case to a different magistrate judge. Although I am fully confident that I am able to fairly, impartially, and disinterestedly adjudicate any issues that may come before me in this matter, 28 U.S.C. § 455(a) instructs that a Magistrate Judge "shall disqualify himself in any proceeding in which his impartiality might reasonably be questioned." For the reasons previously stated, ECF No. 16, I hereby recuse myself from this matter in order to avoid the appearance of impropriety. Entered by Magistrate Judge Cyrus Y. Chung on 12/30/2025. Text Only Entry. (agryan) (Entered: 12/30/2025)
